description: Read-only Git metadata comparison of two explicit refs, not promotion policy or execution readiness. Optional declaredEdge assesses only exact-source-commit containment in the target, with the same source-to-target direction for promotion and back-promotion. Local snapshot only; remote freshness and remote BU synchronization are unknown. No inferred branch roles or backpromotions, auth/log/artifact/commit-content reads, branch changes or native mcdev/live execution. Prevent concurrent project/Git mutation; not an atomic snapshot. Separate from inspect_mcdev_project auth protection checks.

declaredEdge.description: Optional caller-declared intent; never reverses source and target.

sourceRef.description: Explicit source branch or full ref, never a revision expression.

targetRef.description: Explicit target branch or full ref, never a revision expression.

name: inspect_mcdev_git_range
